reddit_quotes: I've used Black Diamond Headlamp for 11 months. The build quality is evident the moment you hold it.
Black Diamond Headlamp is the kind of thing you don't appreciate until you've used the cheap alternative and regretted it.
The Black Diamond Headlamp community is split, but the people who actually own them tend to keep them.
detractor_quote: I returned my Black Diamond Headlamp after two weeks. The QC was terrible.
